newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-DISTANCE RUNNER WASSILUK DROPPED FOR DOPING.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-DISTANCE RUNNER WASSILUK DROPPED FOR DOPING.

text.p: Distance runner Petra Wassiluk has been dropped from the German team for the world championships starting on Saturday after a positive dope test.

German Athletic Federation (DLV) officials said on Wednesday that the 27-year-old 10,000 metres runner had been found to have excess levels of the stimulant caffeine in her body during a doping test in Spain last April.
Although Wassiluk's three-month suspension ends before the championships begin, she had been dropped from the German team because she produced her best qualifying times during the period of the ban.
"It's very annoying and regrettable that something like this should happen before a world championships," said DLV president Helmut Diegel.
"Tests were carried out in Lausanne and it was found that there was no genetic reason for the high levels so a rule has been broken."

International Amateur Athletic Federation officials were discussing on Wednesday whether to abandon three-month bans for stimulants and replace them with a formal warning. A second offence would then result in a longer ban.
